claims.label: Grok Summary Asserts Podcast #1 Global Ranking per Podscribe
claims.claim: A Grok-generated summary the host reads states that the "Candace" podcast reached the top global ranking per Podscribe data, following the 2024 Daily Wire departure, and that Owens credits the growth to criticism, the Macron defamation lawsuit and her team's resilience, and attributes the milestone to divine intervention.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check Podscribe ranking data independently; verify whether Grok's characterizations of growth causation match primary data.

claims.label: Host Concurs Grok Summary is Fact-Checked and True
claims.claim: The host asserts the Grok summary is "fact-checked" and that all of it is "very true."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify which elements of the Grok summary the host is endorsing as primary fact versus host editorialization.

claims.label: Erika Kirk States She Has Not Been Angry with God
claims.claim: Erika Kirk, in the Fox News interview, states that she has never felt anger toward God over Charlie's death, in contrast to C. S. Lewis in *A Grief Observed*.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against full unedited interview audio; identify whether additional context was cut from the broadcast.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Does Not Give Direct Yes/No on Whether Husband's Killer Was Caught
claims.claim: When Jesse Watters asks whether they have caught her husband's killer, Erika Kirk responds by stating she trusts her team and has seen the autopsy report; the host says it is not a straight yes or no.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain unedited interview transcript; assess whether the non-direct answer is consistent across additional Erika Kirk public statements.

claims.label: Erika Kirk States She Has Seen the Autopsy Report and Evidence Portions
claims.claim: Erika Kirk states she has seen the autopsy report and various "evidence portions" that have been collected.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the legal pathway by which a non-lawyer spouse obtains access to autopsy and evidence; cross-check public statements by prosecutors and defense counsel.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Describes Charlie's Saint Michael Pendant as His "Armor"
claims.claim: Erika Kirk states that Charlie loved Saint Michael and that, every time he put on the pendant, he felt it was his armor.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain photographs of the pendant from TPUSA or family sources; verify the metals described ("bronze" with later additions).

claims.label: Priest Visible in Backstage Video at Ole Miss Event Behind Jesse Watters and Erika Kirk
claims.claim: The host says that behind Jesse Watters and Erika Kirk as they walk backstage at the University of Mississippi event, there was a priest looking in the corner, whom she identifies as the same priest Erika took with her to the hospital when Charlie was shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original footage to identify the priest and any associated institution.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Requests Grace for Those Present on Day of Assassination
claims.claim: In an interview clip the host plays, Erika Kirk publicly requests grace for those who were present the day Charlie was assassinated, citing AI-generated fake images and concerns about her children's future internet exposure.
claims.investigative_direction: Catalog the specific AI-generated image claims Erika references; assess the platform-level response to date.

claims.label: Allie Beth Stuckey Asserts UVU Event Was Requested, Not Approved, in July
claims.claim: Allie Beth Stuckey tweets that the UVU campus stop was "requested in July" rather than "approved in July," and that Charlie texted her at the end of August about a November campus event approximately 2 months out.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Allie's underlying text message exchange with Charlie to verify the quoted framing; cross-reference against host's previously displayed email.

claims.label: Allie Beth Stuckey Follows Up That There Was No Venue Yet, Two Months Out
claims.claim: In a tweet the host reads, Allie Beth Stuckey follows up that "no venue yet, 2 months out" was the status of the event at the time of her texts.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying text thread to verify Allie's characterization of venue status.

claims.label: Allie Beth Stuckey Follows Up That There Was No Venue Yet, Two Months Out (revises C-2448 title)
claims.claim: C-2448's title says the venue was confirmed two months out, which inverts its own body. Allie Beth Stuckey follows up that "no venue yet, 2 months out" was the status of the event at the time of her texts.
claims.investigative_direction: Read with C-2448; obtain the underlying text thread to verify Allie's characterization of venue status.
claims.transcript_snippet: She says, "Since some of you guys are struggling, no venue yet, 2 months out."

claims.label: Lila Rose Reports Stanford Event Was to Be Set Up in Three Weeks
claims.claim: Lila Rose tweets that she was just asked to speak at Stanford and that the event was going to be set up within 3 weeks; the host responds that this means the event did not happen or materialize.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Lila Rose's Stanford invitation claim against the host's stated Stanford event-planning baseline.

claims.label: Lila Rose Reports Yale Debate Was Planned Within Two Months
claims.claim: Lila Rose tweets that a recent Yale debate she participated in was planned within 2 months.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the Yale debate date and verify against Yale Political Union scheduling records.

claims.label: Alex Clark Attributes Mikey McCoy's Korea/Japan Trip to Production Director's Request
claims.claim: Alex Clark tweets that Mikey McCoy went to Korea and Japan at the request of TPUSA's production director, who had six children and missed his kids while traveling.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the named production director and verify travel scheduling records.

claims.label: Alex Clark States She Did Not Run Ad Sponsorships on Charlie Tribute Episodes
claims.claim: Alex Clark tweets that on every Charlie tribute episode, she did not run her ad sponsorships, resulting in her team being in debt to her sponsors.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether Alex Clark's tribute episodes were ad-free across all tribute outputs, not selectively.

claims.label: Alyssa Cordova Suggests NDA Exists Between TPUSA and Candace via Blexit
claims.claim: Alyssa Cordova tweets speculation that non-disparagement agreements may be in place between Turning Point USA and Candace Owens due to TPUSA's business arrangement with Blexit.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm or refute the existence of any such NDA through document disclosure or direct party confirmation.

claims.label: Dinesh D'Souza Characterizes the Show as "Freak Show… Bowling"
claims.claim: Dinesh D'Souza posts on X that "anyone who follows this freak show is doing it for the entertainment. This is not political commentary. It's bowling."
claims.investigative_direction: Capture original post timestamp and any subsequent D'Souza commentary on the investigation.

claims.label: Kolby Sessions Publicly Identifies Himself as the Green-Hoodie Figure at the UVU Event
claims.claim: Kolby Sessions posts a social media message identifying himself as the person seen wearing the green hoodie at the UVU event, explaining he and a teammate were on campus to get food and stop by.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Kolby Sessions's UVU student status and the existence of the underlying social media post.

claims.label: Tom Paul Viewer Comment References Andrew Klavan Discussing Charlie's Heartbeat on Alex Clark Show
claims.claim: A viewer (Tom Paul) reports that Andrew Klavan, on the Alex Clark show, discussed how Charlie's heart was still beating, posing a question about how Charlie could have "instantly gone to heaven" if he had a pulse.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the specific Alex Clark show episode and Andrew Klavan segment to verify the exact framing and any offered explanation.

claims.label: Arm Hanna Viewer Comment Endorses Host's Forgiveness Framing
claims.claim: A viewer (Arm Hanna) endorses the host's earlier statement that one cannot forgive until one knows what one is forgiving.
claims.investigative_direction: None – viewer opinion, not an investigative target.

claims.label: Host says Turning Point USA is telling a lot of lies and is engaged in a cover-up
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA is telling a lot of lies and is engaged in a cover-up, that she puts her name on that and will not apologise; she ties it to the Catholicism statements she says Alex Clark lied about.
claims.investigative_direction: List the specific TPUSA statements the host calls lies and compare each against the record.
claims.transcript_snippet: Turning Point USA's telling a lot of lies. They're engaged in a cover-up. I said it. I'm putting my name on that.

claims.label: Host Says Podcast Spent Nothing on Advertising in Its First Year and a Half
claims.claim: The host says her podcast reached number one worldwide without promotion and that since it started a year and a half ago she has not spent a single dollar on advertising.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Podscribe ranking data for the date with any ad-spend disclosures from the show.
claims.transcript_snippet: which means we have not spent, since we started this podcast a year and a half ago, a single dollar on advertising, okay?

claims.label: Host Says Daily Wire Leaders Fired Her
claims.claim: The host says Ben Shapiro and Jeremy Boreing fired her, thanking them sarcastically for the firing and its publicity.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the 2024 separation announcements from the host and Daily Wire for the stated reason and date.
claims.transcript_snippet: I thank Ben Shapiro. I thank Jeremy Boreing. I thank the direction of travel, and they realizing it before I did, um that I should be fired.

claims.label: Host Says She Stopped Doing the Pro-Israel Thing
claims.claim: The host says the Kanye West song Power taught her to stop listening to haters and to have the courage to say 'I know the crowd is doing this, but I'm not doing it,' and that this was her when she no longer wanted to do the pro-Israel thing.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's pre-2024 statements on Israel with later ones to date the change.
claims.transcript_snippet: I know the crowd is doing this, but I'm not doing it." And that was me when I no longer wanted to do the pro-Israel thing.

claims.label: Host Says Australia Banned Her
claims.claim: The host says Australian minister Tony Burke banned her from the entire country, and at 01:01:57 says she can reapply in about a year.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Australian Home Affairs visa decision and the stated reason and reapplication period.
claims.transcript_snippet: Tony Burke, thank you for banning us from an entire country, even though I didn't do nothing.

claims.label: Host Says Four People Work on the Podcast Every Day
claims.claim: The host says only four people work on the actual podcast every day and that the team has stayed small.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the staff the host later describes or lists in company filings.
claims.transcript_snippet: There's just four of us, uh that work on the actual podcast every day.

claims.label: Host Says Watters Also Followed Erika at the Ole Miss Event With Vance
claims.claim: The host says Jesse Watters, who hosted the Fox News interview with Erika Kirk, also trailed her at the University of Mississippi event she did with J. D. Vance.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Ole Miss event date, the Fox News Primetime broadcast date and any pooled footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: also trailed her at the event that she did with J. D. Vance at the University of Mississippi.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Told the Memorial Crowd She Forgave the Killer
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk said on stage, quite quickly after the assassination, that she forgave him.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the memorial-service video and transcript for the forgiveness statement and its timing.
claims.transcript_snippet: she got up on stage, and she said that I forgive him pretty pretty instantly.

claims.label: Host Says Memorial Event Was on the 21st After Correction
claims.claim: The host says the memorial event was 10 or 11 days after the assassination, then says nine days, and after a correction from her director says it was on the 21st.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the memorial service date; the host's arithmetic of nine days does not match the 21st if the shooting was September 10, so check against the official date.
claims.transcript_snippet: Nine days after he was assassinated. Oh, sorry, the 21st. Mansplained in my ear.

claims.label: Host Says She Does Not Believe Robinson Was the Lone Person Involved
claims.claim: The host says she does not believe Tyler Robinson was the lone person involved, and says 'I don't even think this person that killed Charlie Kirk' before trailing off.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the prosecution's evidence base and any filings naming co-participants.
claims.transcript_snippet: I don't believe that he was the lone person involved. I don't even think this person that killed Charlie Kirk.

claims.label: Host Says She Cannot Forgive Until She Knows What Happened
claims.claim: The host says she cannot forgive Tyler Robinson because she does not know what she would be forgiving until she knows what happened.
claims.investigative_direction: Opinion framing; track whether the host later states what she believes happened.
claims.transcript_snippet: it's because I cannot forgive until I know what happened. I don't know what I'm forgiving actually until I know what happened.

claims.label: Host Says the Public Has Not Seen the Autopsy Report
claims.claim: The host says that, unlike Erika Kirk, none of the public has seen the autopsy report.
claims.investigative_direction: Check whether the Utah autopsy record has been released or sealed.
claims.transcript_snippet: Obviously, we have none of us have seen the autopsy report.

claims.label: Host Says Bowyer Claimed TPUSA Has 4K Footage
claims.claim: The host says Tyler Bowyer said they have footage in 4K of everything from when Charlie was tweeting.
claims.investigative_direction: Find Bowyer's original statement and ask TPUSA what 4K footage exists and who holds it.
claims.transcript_snippet: Tyler Bowyer said, we have footage in 4K all of the stuff when he was tweeting.

claims.label: Host Says Someone Claimed Every Area of the University Is Covered by Cameras
claims.claim: The host says someone other than the university said that at every angle every area of the university is covered by cameras.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who made the claim and obtain the UVU camera inventory and retention records.
claims.transcript_snippet: not the university, but somebody else was was saying that you know, at every angle, every area of the university is covered.

claims.label: Host Says the Excuse for Withholding Footage Was Not Impacting the Case
claims.claim: The host says the excuse given for not showing the public the footage was that it might impact the case, and that it never made sense to her given a manhunt was underway.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the official statements giving the reason and the timing of any footage releases during the manhunt.
claims.transcript_snippet: Their excuse for not showing the public was they didn't want it to in any way impact the case.

claims.label: Host Says Her Tribute Said Only That They Hoped Charlie Would Become Catholic
claims.claim: The host says her tribute video said they were all hoping Charlie would take the step and become Catholic, giving no details, after which Christian Zionist influencers said it was untrue.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the tribute video and the influencers' responses against what was said.
claims.transcript_snippet: we were all hoping that he was going to take the step and become Catholic. Gave no details

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Did Not Convert to Catholicism
claims.claim: The host says she said from the beginning that Charlie Kirk did not convert to Catholicism and that she only reported where he was on his spiritual journey.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Charlie's priests and Church records whether he was baptized or received into the Church.
claims.transcript_snippet: Like I said from the beginning, he didn't convert to Catholicism.

claims.label: Erika Says Her Phone Went Dark for Weeks and She Insulated Herself
claims.claim: In the Fox News audio, Erika Kirk says her phone died, became a black hole, and she did not turn it on for weeks, and that she intentionally insulated herself to guard her heart.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with Erika's public posting and contact record in the weeks after September 10.
claims.transcript_snippet: my phone died. It became a black hole. I just didn't turn it on for weeks on end.

claims.label: Host Says Officials Told Obvious Lies Including a .30-06 Bullet Being Stopped
claims.claim: The host says the feds are telling obvious lies, number one being that Charlie was shot by a .30-06 and the bullet was stopped when in a normal circumstance it would have decapitated him.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the ballistics report, caliber finding and wound description from the official record.
claims.transcript_snippet: Number one being that he was shot by a.30-06 and stopped the bullet when in a normal circumstance it would have decapitated him.

claims.label: Host Says Mikey McCoy Was Billed to Take Over Charlie's Liberty Event
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA has said Mikey McCoy will take over Charlie's Liberty University event, which is going to be sold out, and that TPUSA faith directors tell people he has what it takes.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the Liberty University convocation schedule and any TPUSA announcement of McCoy as replacement.
claims.transcript_snippet: Mikey's going to take over for Charlie at his Liberty convocate or Liberty event that he has which is is going to be sold out

claims.label: Host Says She Took Two Weeks Away and Took the Show Off the Air for Days
claims.claim: The host says she went away for two weeks to collect her thoughts about the trauma of having watched the shooting and took the show off the air for a couple of days.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the show's publishing record in September 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: I had to go away for 2 weeks to collect my thoughts about the trauma that I saw having watched it.

claims.label: Host Calls Tyler Bowyer a Sexual Deviant
claims.claim: The host, objecting to calls for grace for Tyler Bowyer, says he is a sexual deviant and that the company he heads should be committed to truth.
claims.investigative_direction: Allegation stated without evidence on air; ask the host what documents support it.
claims.transcript_snippet: Tyler Bowyer is a sexual deviant, right?

claims.label: Host Says Alex Clark Wanted the WSJ Moment Until Host Caught a Lie
claims.claim: The host says Alex Clark wanted to do the Wall Street Journal thing until the host caught a lie about what she said about Catholics.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the WSJ piece and Clark's statements about Catholicism that the host calls untrue.
claims.transcript_snippet: Alex Clark wanted to do the Wall Street Journal thing until I caught like this little lie

claims.label: Host Says She Posted a Clear Image of the Green Hoodie Figure
claims.claim: The host says that after Sam Parker asked who the guys in the video were, she replied with a clear image of the person in the green hoodie and that person quickly answered that it was him.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original post thread with timestamps.
claims.transcript_snippet: I then respond and I'm like, "Here's a clear image of this person, the actual person wearing the green hoodie."

claims.label: Host Believes Kolby Sessions Is on the UVU Soccer Team
claims.claim: The host says she thinks Kolby Sessions is on the soccer team at UVU.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the UVU athletics roster for Sessions.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think he's on the soccer team at UVU.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Staff Were Back on Their Feet and Sharing Memories the Next Day
claims.claim: The host says that, despite claiming to be in mourning, TPUSA figures were back on their feet the next day, giddy, and sharing detailed memories of the day.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect dated interviews and posts from TPUSA staff on September 11-12.
